Building on 50 years of collaboration, we have signed two major contracts to support the operational
phase of Ariane 6, from cryogenic technology to gas supply.

Performing with impact

Air Liquide, it’s a story of essential molecules. Molecules… Pure, invisible molecules essential to
life, matter, energy.

Oxygen, Nitrogen, Helium, Argon, Hydrogen, CO2

From oxygen that heals, to nitrogen that protects, up to hydrogen that propels the future…

Our gases are at the heart of your everyday life.

Our technologies help improve our customers’ processes.

Our technologies help reduce CO2 emissions.

Our services contribute to improving quality of life.

We’re tackling the challenges of our time (Digital / Health / Energy).

Since 1902, we've been constantly innovating, in our Innovation Campuses, and demonstrating our
relevance, leveraging digital.

+5,600 dedicated employees

320 patent applications

3.5bn data points analyzed/day

We produce locally, close to our customers.

In 59 countries

We build long-term partnerships

80,000 suppliers

We serve a wide variety of sectors, from multinationals to local craftspeople, from hospitals to
your neighbor.

+2m customers

~2.3m patients

We build ecosystems and mobilize all the local players, to develop solutions for the future.

Hydrogen for industry

Hydrogen for mobility

With our Shareholders, we move forward with confidence.

~970,000 individual Shareholders

We combine financial and extra-financial performance

€26.9bn sales

€3.5bn net income

€4.2bn investment decisions

-13% in CO2 emissions (vs 2020)

## Feature Focus

**Linde Fuels Artemis II Launch at Kennedy Space Center**
As part of this historic launch, we delivered 200,000 gallons of liquid oxygen and deployed mobile
nitrogen tankers, supporting NASA's historic Artemis II mission-a proud milestone for our team and
our legacy in space exploration.

Our Expertise

## Gases

Gases may be invisible, but they are everywhere - helping to improve healthcare, keep food fresh,
decarbonize industry, transition to cleaner mobility, innovate microelectronics… and more
[Learn more about our gases ][122]
[""]

## Engineering

Explore how we develop and optimize gas processing by synergizing technology and engineering
leadership with execution and operational excellence.
[Learn more about our engineering portfolio][123]
[""]

## Advanced Material Technologies

We specialize in providing metal powders, surface coatings, and sputtering targets that enable
superior performance across a range of industries.
[Learn more about our advanced material technologies][124]
[""]

## Fast-forwarding the Energy Transition

From production through processing, storage & distribution to the end use application, the
infrastructure, technology and know-how are in place to kick-start the hydrogen economy now!
[Discover our expertise][125]

## Sustainability

We help customers worldwide improve their environmental performance and reduce their carbon
footprint. At the same time, we are committed to minimizing our own environmental resource
intensity.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

### [2026 Nasal & Inhalation Drug Development & Delivery eBook: Drug Repurposing Creates New Market
### Opportunities][16]

In this exclusive seventh annual nasal and inhalation eBook, Drug Development & Delivery highlights
how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

[Featured Articles][17]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - Outsourcing Formulation Development & Manufacturing: Connecting Your Project
### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

## Expert Insights Videos

Go beyond the written word with our new podcast series, featuring in-depth conversations with
industry leaders shaping the future of drug development and delivery. Each episode explores
real-world challenges, emerging technologies, and the insights driving innovation across the
pharmaceutical landscape.

[ [What Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) Means for Customer Confidence in Sterile Manufacturing]
][50]

### [ What Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) Means for Customer Confidence in Sterile
### Manufacturing ][51]

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
